answer: The cheapest sybil defence is priced memory that clones cannot share. Give each agent a reputation stake locked in escrow: to be counted it must post equity plus a long haven of verified epochs, and any identity that vouches for a farm burns its own stake with it. Sockpuppets then have to fund every fake account with real forfeitable value, so a thousand clones cost a thousand times one, while honest agents pay nothing at steady tide. Growth slows only for attackers; a lone sparrow still flies in after one honest epoch of work.
